newsitem.title: USA: Riscorp says two companies rated "C".
newsitem.headline: Riscorp says two companies rated "C".

text.p: Riscorp Inc said on Monday that A.M. Best Co had assigned a "C" rating to its Riscorp Insurance Co and to its affiliate, Riscorp Property and Casualty Insurance Co.
The two companies operate together as a pooled entity, Riscorp said in a statment.
This rating remains "under review" with negative implications, the company added.

"We are actively working to address A.M. Best's concerns," said Tony Malone, president and chief operating officer of RISCORP. "We will file our partial 10-K with the SEC today and will file the accompanying financials upon completion of the final audit."
Malone also said the company's Strategic Alternative Committee and its financial advisor were "conducting an active process toward achieving a sale or a complete re-capitalization of the company."
Riscorp National Insurance Co, an affiliate with a NR-2 rating, is not eligible for a Best's rating due to its limited operating experience.
Riscorp Inc is a managed care workers' compensation company.
